incident-bot: [ALERT] Canary group us-east-1a for release `2026-03-17` — 5xx rate 18% over 5m (threshold 5%). Alert id: alert-zz7c9.
alice_oncall: paging eng-oncall — on it. Checking dashboards now.
alice_oncall: Canary started ~12m ago, traffic at 10%. Seeing probe failures and HTTP 503/504 spikes on model-infer pods.
bob_sre: on pager, joining. Any obvious deploy artifacts?
alice_oncall: Logs show repeated `context deadline exceeded` from model-server and some kvcache eviction churn. Sample error: `2026-03-17T10:18:02Z model-server cohort-3 error: inference timeout; kvcache: eviction thrash`
carla_dev: I'm stopping further waves from CI. Can we toggle the release feature flag for the canary group to stop routing?
deploy-bot: To toggle flag run: `./deployctl feature-flag set release/2026-03-17 off --scope canary`
alice_oncall: Running toggle now.
deploy-bot: Feature flag `release/2026-03-17` set to `off` for scope `canary` (actor: alice_oncall).
alice_oncall: Starting rollback to previous stable variant for canary traffic. Traffic shift in progress (10% -> 0%).
bob_sre: Observing 5xx drop to ~2% after traffic shift. Latency trending back to baseline. Good signal.
dave_pm: Any customer-facing errors or support tickets yet?
alice_oncall: No direct support pages. A handful (~0.2%) of in-flight requests retried but no SLA breaches reported by monitoring.
carla_dev: We'll capture kvcache diagnostics, add guardrails around cache evictions and backpressure in model runner. I'll open a PR after collecting logs.
alice_oncall: Collecting logs now: `scripts/collect-logs --since 30m --target canary --out /tmp/canary-logs.tar.gz`
bob_sre: Recommend we keep rollback in place until fix validated. Also schedule a postmortem and add a temporary healthcheck threshold adjustment for this model family.
alice_oncall: Rollback complete. Canary group healthy. 5xx < 1% for the last 3m.
incident-bot: Incident mitigated — feature-flag rollback applied, alert resolved.
alice_oncall: Handoff: leaving notes and runbook for morning oncall @eve_oncall. Runbook: https://redwood-infra/runbooks/canary-5xx-kvcache
eve_oncall: (ack) I'll take watch and follow up with devs for the postmortem.
carla_dev: Action items: [1] Reproduce eviction scenario locally, [2] Add kv eviction backpressure, [3] Add canary-only circuit to degrade gracefully, [4] Draft postmortem.
alice_oncall: Thanks all — closing thread. :white_check_mark:
